# Open-vs-closed 第二次增量复核：修复你指出的根级引用缺口
你前次真实会话指出 Arc 根级 sources 缺少支持 6 月 16 日和先前初始推出的独立出处。下方是已在影子草稿进行的**精确改动**：Arc 根级增加 interconnects-glm52-2026、glm52-hf-commits-20261017、glm52-hf-tree-20261017，各 supports geopolitical-twist；审查证据增加三条与文件 sha 绑定、原文逐字可定位的章级摘录。Arc 原全文叙述/章节锚点顺序没有其他改动；顺序依叙述编排而非严格时间序列，正文明确 DeepSeek 四月在前。HF 三端点为同一仓库历史，不能计三组独立起源。请只根据下列数据判断修复充分与否，给 ACCEPT_FINAL_DELTA_DRAFT/REVISE/HOLD，不得授权发布，未知请写未知。现有 editorial.reviewedAt/reviewer 仍是之前版本，需在审稿成功后与真实会话绑定。


## 完整最新 Arc 草稿
```json
{
  "id": "open-vs-closed",
  "title": {
    "en": "Open Weights, Closed Services: Paths to AI Access",
    "zhHans": "开放权重与封闭服务：AI 的不同访问路径"
  },
  "searchTitle": {
    "en": "Open Weights vs Proprietary AI: Licenses, Access and Distribution",
    "zhHans": "开放权重与专有 AI：许可、访问与分发"
  },
  "searchSummary": {
    "en": "From GPT-3 API access and LLaMA research licensing to later open-weight releases: how AI model access, redistribution rights and verification differ.",
    "zhHans": "从 GPT-3 的 API 访问、LLaMA 的研究许可到后来的开放权重发布：模型访问、再分发权利与性能核实有何不同。"
  },
  "subtitle": {
    "en": "Model access, redistribution rights and performance are different questions",
    "zhHans": "模型访问、再分发权利与性能，是三个不同的问题"
  },
  "coverTheme": "capability",
  "status": "published",
  "significance": 3,
  "abstract": {
    "en": "Closed APIs, downloadable model weights and shared protocols offer different kinds of access. From GPT-3 and LLaMA through DeepSeek and later Chinese open-weight releases, this Arc examines what changed in availability and licensing—and what remains a company-reported performance claim. A market selloff after a model release does not prove single-cause attribution; published weights do not automatically grant unrestricted rights or show widespread use. The question is who can run, modify and distribute a model, under which conditions.",
    "zhHans": "封闭 API、可下载模型权重和共享协议，提供的是不同种类的访问方式。从 GPT-3、LLaMA 到 DeepSeek 及后来的中国开放权重模型，本专题考察可用性和许可条件发生了什么变化，以及哪些性能说法仍只来自厂商。模型发布后的市场下跌不能证明单一原因；公开权重也不自动意味着无限制使用或广泛采用。关键问题是谁能在什么条件下运行、修改和分发模型。"
  },
  "chapters": [
    {
      "id": "closed-default",
      "title": {
        "en": "Access Through Services",
        "zhHans": "通过服务获取能力"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "GPT-3 was offered through an API rather than a public download of its model weights. DALL·E 2, GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT likewise illustrate ways people could use a product without receiving the underlying model. These arrangements differ in pricing, interface and intended use; calling them all “closed” can obscure those differences. They also do not establish that no downloadable models existed at the time, or that compute alone determined each release decision. The useful comparison for this Arc is narrower: service access can be valuable without granting permission to inspect, run independently or redistribute model weights. Later releases tested different combinations of those permissions.",
        "zhHans": "GPT-3 通过 API 提供服务，而不是让公众下载模型权重。DALL·E 2、GitHub Copilot 和 ChatGPT 也展示了用户能使用产品、却无法获得底层模型的不同方式。这些安排在定价、界面和用途上并不一样，笼统称为“闭源”容易遮蔽差别。它们也不能证明当时没有任何可下载模型，或算力是每项发布决定的唯一原因。本专题更有意义的比较范围是：服务访问可以有价值，但不等于获准检查、独立运行或再分发模型权重。后续发布尝试了这些权限的不同组合。"
      },
      "anchorEvents": [
        "gpt3-2020",
        "dall-e-2-2022",
        "github-copilot-2022",
        "chatgpt-2022"
      ],
      "keyInsight": {
        "en": "Access to a model-backed service is not the same as access to its weights or a license to redistribute them.",
        "zhHans": "使用由模型提供的服务，不等于获取模型权重，更不等于取得再分发许可。"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "the-fork-appears",
      "title": {
        "en": "More Routes to Downloadable Models",
        "zhHans": "获取可下载模型的更多路径"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "Stable Diffusion’s release in 2022 gave people another way to run image generation outside a single hosted service. Meta made the original LLaMA weights available to approved researchers under a restricted license in 2023; unauthorized redistribution was not the same thing as a permissive open-source release. Later Llama models, including Llama 3.1 405B, broadened the range of downloadable weights, though a model’s license and deployment costs still determine what users can do. These events show multiple ways AI systems can be shared; none alone establishes a universal capability ranking or a single cause for subsequent research.",
        "zhHans": "2022 年 Stable Diffusion 的发布，为人们在单一托管服务之外运行图像生成提供了另一种方式。2023 年，Meta 依限制性许可向获批研究人员提供初版 LLaMA 权重；未经授权的再分发，不等于宽松的开源发布。后来包括 Llama 3.1 405B 在内的模型扩展了可下载权重的选择，但许可证和部署成本仍决定用户实际能做什么。这些事件展示了共享 AI 系统的多种方式；任何单一事件都不能确立普遍的能力排名，或成为后续研究的唯一原因。"
      },
      "anchorEvents": [
        "stable-diffusion-2022",
        "llama-2023",
        "llama-3.1-405b-2024"
      ],
      "keyInsight": {
        "en": "Research access, unauthorized copying, licensed weight downloads and application code involve different permissions.",
        "zhHans": "研究访问、未经授权的复制、附许可的权重下载和应用代码，涉及不同权限。"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "efficiency-shock",
      "title": {
        "en": "Capability Claims and a Market Reaction",
        "zhHans": "性能主张与市场反应"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "DeepSeek released R1 in January 2025 with downloadable weights and published technical claims about reasoning performance and training efficiency. Financial reporting also described a sharp Nvidia share-price fall days later and cited DeepSeek among investors’ concerns. A market move has multiple potential drivers; timing and commentary cannot establish how much of the price change the release caused. Nor does a company’s stated training cost define the full cost of comparable systems under equal accounting. Llama 4 and GPT-5 are additional model releases in this chapter, not controlled benchmark subjects for a direct R1 comparison. R1 changed what users could inspect and run; whether it matched any particular proprietary model depends on independently specified tasks, measurements and deployment conditions.",
        "zhHans": "DeepSeek 于 2025 年 1 月发布 R1 权重，并披露推理性能和训练效率方面的技术主张。财经报道还记述了几天后 Nvidia 股价大幅下跌，并提到投资者关注 DeepSeek。市场波动可能由多种因素驱动；时间先后与市场评论无法确定该发布造成了多少价格变化。厂商公布的训练费用，也不能在未统一核算口径时直接当作与其他系统的完整成本比较。本章另外列出的 Llama 4 和 GPT-5 是后续模型发布，并非与 R1 进行受控基准比较的对象。R1 改变了用户可检查和运行的内容；它是否与某个专有模型相当，仍取决于独立明确的任务、测量和部署条件。"
      },
      "anchorEvents": [
        "deepseek-r1-2025",
        "llama-4-2025",
        "gpt5-2025"
      ],
      "keyInsight": {
        "en": "A downloadable release and a large contemporaneous selloff are observable; cost superiority and single-cause market attribution require separate proof.",
        "zhHans": "权重发布与同期市场大跌是可观察事实；成本优势和单一原因的市场归因，需要另外证明。"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "geopolitical-twist",
      "title": {
        "en": "Access Restrictions and Alternative Releases",
        "zhHans": "访问限制与其他发布"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "The US export directive concerning Anthropic’s Fable 5 and Mythos 5 restricted access to those models in June 2026. After an earlier initial rollout, Z.ai made GLM-5.2’s MIT-licensed weights available on June 16; DeepSeek V4 had appeared earlier in April. These are different decisions by different actors; their sequence cannot show that the directive caused either release. GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek V4 illustrate alternative ways to make weights available, but vendor-reported benchmark and cost figures are not independent proof that they matched a proprietary frontier model. Licensing and technical access vary between releases, and geographic access rules may differ from product policies. The existence of an alternative is relevant to discussions of access, not evidence that export controls were ineffective or that unrestricted cross-border adoption followed.",
        "zhHans": "2026 年 6 月，美国针对 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 发布出口指令，限制相关模型的访问。Z.ai 先前进行了初始推出，随后于 6 月 16 日以 MIT 许可开放 GLM-5.2 权重；DeepSeek V4 则已于同年 4 月发布。这些是不同主体作出的不同决定，时间顺序不能证明出口指令促成了其中任何一次发布。GLM-5.2 与 DeepSeek V4 展示了其他权重可用方式，但厂商公布的基准和成本数字，不能独立证明它们追平某个专有前沿模型。不同发布的许可和技术访问条件并不相同，地域访问规则也可能区别于产品政策。其他模型的存在与访问讨论有关，却不能据此断言出口管制无效或跨境采用已经不受限制。"
      },
      "anchorEvents": [
        "claude-fable-ban-2026",
        "glm-52-open-source-2026",
        "deepseek-v4-2026"
      ],
      "keyInsight": {
        "en": "The proximity of restrictions and weight releases raises an access question, not evidence of a causal policy reversal.",
        "zhHans": "访问限制与权重发布的时间接近，提出了访问问题，但不足以证明政策造成了反向结果。"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "fork-ahead",
      "title": {
        "en": "More Than a Binary Choice",
        "zhHans": "不只是二选一"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "The distinction between model access and model openness became harder to reduce to a binary choice. OpenAI’s public-benefit-corporation restructuring, Sora’s discontinuation, the Model Context Protocol, and OpenClaw concern different layers of the industry: ownership, product continuity, interoperability, and software distribution. None of these events alone demonstrates that open and proprietary models reached performance parity. On October 15, StepFun made Step 5 Preview weights available under its Model License 1.0. The model repository describes self-hosted inference, while the license adds attribution and commercial-use conditions. It is an example of available weights with conditions, not unrestricted open-source licensing; neither its availability nor company-reported benchmarks establish independent performance parity or broad production adoption. The open–closed question therefore also concerns who can deploy, modify, and redistribute a model, and under what terms.",
        "zhHans": "模型可访问性与模型开放程度之间的区别，越来越难用二元选择概括。OpenAI 重组为公益公司、Sora 停运、模型上下文协议和 OpenClaw 涉及产业的不同层面：所有权、产品延续、互操作性与软件分发。单凭其中任何一件事，都不能证明开放权重模型与专有模型性能相当。10 月 15 日，阶跃星辰依据 Model License 1.0 开放 Step 5 Preview 权重。模型仓库介绍了自托管推理方式，而许可证另有署名和商业使用条件。这是附带条件的权重可用实例，并非不受限制的开源许可；权重开放和厂商披露的基准结果，都不能证明性能已获独立验证或生产环境已广泛采用。因此，开放与封闭的争论还涉及谁能部署、修改、再分发模型，以及必须遵守哪些条件。"
      },
      "anchorEvents": [
        "openai-pbc-restructure-2025",
        "mcp-protocol-2024",
        "sora-shutdown-2026",
        "openclaw-2026",
        "stepfun-step-5-preview-open-weights-2026"
      ],
      "keyInsight": {
        "en": "Available weights do not by themselves establish unrestricted redistribution, independently verified performance or production adoption.",
        "zhHans": "权重可获取本身，并不意味着可不受限制地再分发、性能已获独立核实或已在生产环境采用。"
      }
    }
  ],
  "conclusion": {
    "en": "The examples in this Arc distinguish access to a service from access to weights, and both from permission to reuse them. LLaMA’s limited research release, later downloadable models and Step 5 Preview’s conditional license did not confer the same rights. DeepSeek R1 was discussed alongside a large market selloff, but a temporal sequence cannot isolate its contribution to price changes. Likewise, selected or company-run benchmarks cannot establish general parity between model families. Open and proprietary approaches may coexist; neither licensing labels nor a single release can settle which approach will prevail. Future comparisons need independent testing of defined tasks, evidence of actual adoption and close reading of the relevant terms.",
    "zhHans": "本专题的案例区分了服务访问、权重获取和再使用许可。LLaMA 最初有限的研究许可、后来的可下载模型和 Step 5 Preview 附带条件的许可证，赋予的权利并不相同。DeepSeek R1 发布期间出现大规模市场下跌，但时间先后不能分离出它对价格变化的具体贡献。同样，选定的或厂商自行披露的基准测试，也不能证明不同模型系列普遍性能相当。开放与专有路线可能共存；许可证标签和单次发布都不足以判定哪条路线将占优。今后的比较需要针对明确任务的独立测试、实际采用证据，以及对相关条款的仔细核对。"

# Open-vs-closed 第二次增量复核：修复你指出的根级引用缺口
你前次真实会话指出 Arc 根级 sources 缺少支持 6 月 16 日和先前初始推出的独立出处。下方是已在影子草稿进行的**精确改动**：Arc 根级增加 interconnects-glm52-2026、glm52-hf-commits-20261017、glm52-hf-tree-20261017，各 supports geopolitical-twist；审查证据增加三条与文件 sha 绑定、原文逐字可定位的章级摘录。Arc 原全文叙述/章节锚点顺序没有其他改动；顺序依叙述编排而非严格时间序列，正文明确 DeepSeek 四月在前。HF 三端点为同一仓库历史，不能计三组独立起源。请只根据下列数据判断修复充分与否，给 ACCEPT_FINAL_DELTA_DRAFT/REVISE/HOLD，不得授权发布，未知请写未知。现有 editorial.reviewedAt/reviewer 仍是之前版本，需在审稿成功后与真实会话绑定。


## 完整最新 Arc 草稿

    "en": "Open Weights, Closed Services: Paths to AI Access",

    "en": "From GPT-3 API access and LLaMA research licensing to later open-weight releases: how AI model access, redistribution rights and verification differ.",

  "significance": 3,
  "abstract": {
    "en": "Closed APIs, downloadable model weights and shared protocols offer different kinds of access. From GPT-3 and LLaMA through DeepSeek and later Chinese open-weight releases, this Arc examines what changed in availability and licensing—and what remains a company-reported performance claim. A market selloff after a model release does not prove single-cause attribution; published weights do not automatically grant unrestricted rights or show widespread use. The question is who can run, modify and distribute a model, under which conditions.",
    "zhHans": "封闭 API、可下载模型权重和共享协议，提供的是不同种类的访问方式。从 GPT-3、LLaMA 到 DeepSeek 及后来的中国开放权重模型，本专题考察可用性和许可条件发生了什么变化，以及哪些性能说法仍只来自厂商。模型发布后的市场下跌不能证明单一原因；公开权重也不自动意味着无限制使用或广泛采用。关键问题是谁能在什么条件下运行、修改和分发模型。"
  },

    {
      "id": "closed-default",
      "title": {
        "en": "Access Through Services",
        "zhHans": "通过服务获取能力"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "GPT-3 was offered through an API rather than a public download of its model weights. DALL·E 2, GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT likewise illustrate ways people could use a product without receiving the underlying model. These arrangements differ in pricing, interface and intended use; calling them all “closed” can obscure those differences. They also do not establish that no downloadable models existed at the time, or that compute alone determined each release decision. The useful comparison for this Arc is narrower: service access can be valuable without granting permission to inspect, run independently or redistribute model weights. Later releases tested different combinations of those permissions.",
        "zhHans": "GPT-3 通过 API 提供服务，而不是让公众下载模型权重。DALL·E 2、GitHub Copilot 和 ChatGPT 也展示了用户能使用产品、却无法获得底层模型的不同方式。这些安排在定价、界面和用途上并不一样，笼统称为“闭源”容易遮蔽差别。它们也不能证明当时没有任何可下载模型，或算力是每项发布决定的唯一原因。本专题更有意义的比较范围是：服务访问可以有价值，但不等于获准检查、独立运行或再分发模型权重。后续发布尝试了这些权限的不同组合。"

        "chatgpt-2022"

        "zhHans": "使用由模型提供的服务，不等于获取模型权重，更不等于取得再分发许可。"

      "id": "the-fork-appears",
      "title": {

        "zhHans": "获取可下载模型的更多路径"
      },
      "narrative": {
        "en": "Stable Diffusion’s release in 2022 gave people another way to run image generation outside a single hosted service. Meta made the original LLaMA weights available to approved researchers under a restricted license in 2023; unauthorized redistribution was not the same thing as a permissive open-source release. Later Llama models, including Llama 3.1 405B, broadened the range of downloadable weights, though a model’s license and deployment costs still determine what users can do. These events show multiple ways AI systems can be shared; none alone establishes a universal capability ranking or a single cause for subsequent research.",
        "zhHans": "2022 年 Stable Diffusion 的发布，为人们在单一托管服务之外运行图像生成提供了另一种方式。2023 年，Meta 依限制性许可向获批研究人员提供初版 LLaMA 权重；未经授权的再分发，不等于宽松的开源发布。后来包括 Llama 3.1 405B 在内的模型扩展了可下载权重的选择，但许可证和部署成本仍决定用户实际能做什么。这些事件展示了共享 AI 系统的多种方式；任何单一事件都不能确立普遍的能力排名，或成为后续研究的唯一原因。"
      },

        "llama-3.1-405b-2024"
      ],
      "keyInsight": {
        "en": "Research access, unauthorized copying, licensed weight downloads and application code involve different permissions.",
        "zhHans": "研究访问、未经授权的复制、附许可的权重下载和应用代码，涉及不同权限。"

      "id": "efficiency-shock",

        "en": "Capability Claims and a Market Reaction",

      },

        "en": "DeepSeek released R1 in January 2025 with downloadable weights and published technical claims about reasoning performance and training efficiency. Financial reporting also described a sharp Nvidia share-price fall days later and cited DeepSeek among investors’ concerns. A market move has multiple potential drivers; timing and commentary cannot establish how much of the price change the release caused. Nor does a company’s stated training cost define the full cost of comparable systems under equal accounting. Llama 4 and GPT-5 are additional model releases in this chapter, not controlled benchmark subjects for a direct R1 comparison. R1 changed what users could inspect and run; whether it matched any particular proprietary model depends on independently specified tasks, measurements and deployment conditions.",
        "zhHans": "DeepSeek 于 2025 年 1 月发布 R1 权重，并披露推理性能和训练效率方面的技术主张。财经报道还记述了几天后 Nvidia 股价大幅下跌，并提到投资者关注 DeepSeek。市场波动可能由多种因素驱动；时间先后与市场评论无法确定该发布造成了多少价格变化。厂商公布的训练费用，也不能在未统一核算口径时直接当作与其他系统的完整成本比较。本章另外列出的 Llama 4 和 GPT-5 是后续模型发布，并非与 R1 进行受控基准比较的对象。R1 改变了用户可检查和运行的内容；它是否与某个专有模型相当，仍取决于独立明确的任务、测量和部署条件。"

Licensing and technical access vary between releases, and geographic access rules may differ from product policies. The existence of an alternative is relevant to discussions of access, not evidence that export controls were ineffective or that unrestricted cross-border adoption followed.",
        "zhHans": "2026 年 6 月，美国针对 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 发布出口指令，限制相关模型的访问。Z.ai 先前进行了初始推出，随后于 6 月 16 日以 MIT 许可开放 GLM-5.2 权重；DeepSeek V4 则已于同年 4 月发布。这些是不同主体作出的不同决定，时间顺序不能证明出口指令促成了其中任何一次发布。GLM-5.2 与 DeepSeek V4 展示了其他权重可用方式，但厂商公布的基准和成本数字，不能独立证明它们追平某个专有前沿模型。不同发布的许可和技术访问条件并不相同，地域访问规则也可能区别于产品政策。其他模型的存在与访问讨论有关，却不能据此断言出口管制无效或跨境采用已经不受限制。"

        "en": "The distinction between model access and model openness became harder to reduce to a binary choice. OpenAI’s public-benefit-corporation restructuring, Sora’s discontinuation, the Model Context Protocol, and OpenClaw concern different layers of the industry: ownership, product continuity, interoperability, and software distribution. It is an example of available weights with conditions, not unrestricted open-source licensing; neither its availability nor company-reported benchmarks establish independent performance parity or broad production adoption. The open–closed question therefore also concerns who can deploy, modify, and redistribute a model, and under what terms.",
        "zhHans": "模型可访问性与模型开放程度之间的区别，越来越难用二元选择概括。OpenAI 重组为公益公司、Sora 停运、模型上下文协议和 OpenClaw 涉及产业的不同层面：所有权、产品延续、互操作性与软件分发。单凭其中任何一件事，都不能证明开放权重模型与专有模型性能相当。10 月 15 日，阶跃星辰依据 Model License 1.0 开放 Step 5 Preview 权重。模型仓库介绍了自托管推理方式，而许可证另有署名和商业使用条件。这是附带条件的权重可用实例，并非不受限制的开源许可；权重开放和厂商披露的基准结果，都不能证明性能已获独立验证或生产环境已广泛采用。因此，开放与封闭的争论还涉及谁能部署、修改、再分发模型，以及必须遵守哪些条件。"
